hero.title: Data Privacy Policy
hero.orgLine: Gulf of Guinea Maritime Institute · In compliance with Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843)

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: GoGMI respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and protect the personal information of individuals participating in our programmes, including the II MaSSDI Training Course, in compliance with Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

sections.title: Scope
sections.content: This policy applies to all participants, visitors, employees, contractors, and any other individuals whose data is collected, processed, or stored by GoGMI.

sections.title: Legal Basis for Processing
sections.intro: We collect and process personal data under the following lawful bases:

bullets.label: Consent
bullets.text: When you give clear permission to process your data.

bullets.label: Contractual necessity
bullets.text: For fulfilling our agreement with you (e.g., course registration).

bullets.label: Legal obligation
bullets.text: To comply with legal or regulatory requirements.

bullets.label: Legitimate interest
bullets.text: To improve our services, manage operations, or maintain security.

sections.title: Types of Data Collected
sections.intro: We may collect the following types of data:

bullets.label: Personal Identification Data
bullets.text: Name, date of birth, gender, nationality.

bullets.label: Contact Information
bullets.text: Email address, phone number, postal address.

bullets.label: Media
bullets.text: Photographs, video/audio recordings with your consent.

bullets.label: Technical Data
bullets.text: IP addresses, browser types (when using our website).

sections.title: Purpose of Data Collection
sections.intro: Your data may be used for:
list: Registering you for courses and processing payments.
Providing course materials and communicating updates.
Issuing certificates and maintaining alumni records.
Marketing and promotional communications (with opt-out options).
Internal analytics, reporting, and audits.
Compliance with legal and regulatory obligations.

sections.title: Data Sharing and Disclosure
sections.intro: We do not sell your data. We may share your information with:
list: Third-party service providers supporting our operations (e.g., payment processors, course facilitators).
Regulatory bodies or accreditation institutions if legally required.
Partner organizations (e.g., maritime security agencies) for collaborative events or initiatives — only with your consent.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.intro: GoGMI implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to:
list: Protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
Secure electronic and paper-based records.
Limit access to authorized personnel only.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.intro: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to:
list: Fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy.
Comply with legal, accounting, or reporting requirements.
Maintain alumni records unless you request deletion.

sections.title: Your Rights Under Ghana's Data Protection Act
list: Access your personal data.
Request correction or deletion of inaccurate data.
Withdraw consent at any time (where processing is based on consent).
Object to processing under certain circumstances.
Lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Commission (DPC) of Ghana.

sections.title: Use of Cookies
sections.content: Our website may use cookies to enhance user experience. You may adjust browser settings to refuse cookies; however, some functionality may be limited.

sections.title: International Data Transfers
sections.content: If we transfer data outside Ghana (e.g., cloud hosting), we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your information in accordance with Act 843.

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.content: This policy may be updated periodically. The latest version will always be available on our website. Continued use of our services indicates acceptance of any changes.
